verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer built on Stripe, so embedded payment components are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no embeddable or customizable payment UI components. The closest items are a hosted billing portal session (a redirect, the opposite of embedding) and a previewAttach API for showing charges, which is a building block rather than an embedded payment component.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page
